persona: Mid-level SAP QM consultant with procurement-side depth
resumeText:
Snehal Kulkarni | Pune | snehal.kulkarni@example.com

SUMMARY
SAP QM consultant with 5 years on S/4HANA implementation and support projects for automotive and pharma plants.

EXPERIENCE
SAP QM Consultant, Sahyadri Digital Consulting, Pune (2021 - present)
- Configured QM in procurement for goods receipt inspection, quality info records and vendor quality scores.
- Set up master inspection characteristics, sampling procedures and inspection plans for 1,200 purchased materials.
- Configured quality notifications for customer complaints and supplier defects with task and action catalogs.
- Ran fit-gap workshops with plant quality heads and wrote functional specs for 14 enhancements.
- Wrote test scripts and ran integration and user acceptance testing for two plant rollouts.
- Trained 40 key users and presented design decisions to the plant steering committee.

SAP QM Analyst, Deccan Auto Components, Chakan (2019 - 2021)
- Supported inspection lot processing and usage decision errors raised by the receiving lab.
- Worked with MM consultants on goods receipt postings and stock in quality inspection.

SKILLS
SAP QM, SAP MM, SAP PP, S/4HANA, Fiori apps, Excel

EDUCATION
BE Mechanical Engineering, Pune University, 2019
